announcements.headline: Post-Stabilization Notice ING Bank
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the conclusion of a stabilisation period following a securities transaction, which is a standard administrative procedure. It confirms that market support activities have ceased and has no inherent implication for the company's operational performance or value.

announcements.headline: Post-stabilization Notice ING Bank

It generally indicates that any temporary market intervention has ended and the share price will now trade freely based on market forces.
